title: fvm-cli
tagline: A cli tool similar to Hardhat for filecoin, this cli tool will make it easy to develop FVM specific smart contracts.
description:
This project uses solc compiler to generate abi and bytecode of the contract created, it was supposed to be better as per our plan but due to last-minute change in project, we couldn't complete it.
We also generate the artifacts for the contract to be deployed and it's saved under artifacts dir.
how_its_made:
Its made using solc compiler and contracts are deployed on calibration testnet. The compiler generates the abi and bytecode for contract then the user exports private key env which is used to deploy the contract.

The original plan was to create a cli tool that also integrates push protocol along with data deals but it hasn't been implemented in this hackathon.
